title: Fall 2026 | Wood Fire Class AND Firing | TUE | 6-9PM
source_quote:
Fall 2026: Wood Fire Class AND Firing
Tuesdays, 6-9PM (Class meets September 15 to November 3, firing to follow)
evidence_sentence: The class description states wood firing takes place in an Anagama style kiln with students working stoking shifts during a week-long firing.
evidence_quote: Class will culminate in a week-long wood-firing in an Anagama style kiln.
summary: Intermediate to advanced wood-firing class meets Tuesdays 6-9 PM from September 15 to November 3, followed by loading November 6-8, firing November 10-18, and unload November 28-29. Students work 3-4 six-hour stoking shifts. Tuition $380 members / $395 nonmembers.
bring: Bisqued pots (students create pieces during class to fire in the Anagama wood kiln)
commitment: Class Tuesdays 6-9PM Sept 15 - Nov 3; prep work 10-15 hours; stoking shifts Nov 10-18
how_to_join: Register through The Clay Studio of Missoula registration portal
